# PASTEL QR Concierge

Mobile-first static concierge for PASTEL PASTRY&COFFEE.

## Truth policy
Only verified business information is presented. Prices, opening hours, delivery, reservations, availability and other unverified details are not invented.

## Deployment
The intended public target is GitHub Pages at https://salamou1944.github.io/Pastel-/ after the Pages workflow is enabled and verified.

## QR migration
Do not replace the existing QR destination until the new public URL is live and has been tested on a real phone.

Deployment workflow updated to initialize Pages automatically.


Pages verification trigger: 2026-10-03

Pages deployment verification trigger: 2026-10-03T19:00Z

name: Deploy Host Standard to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "host-standard/**"
      - ".github/workflows/pages-host-standard.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5

      - name: Upload Host Standard artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: host-standard

      - name: Deploy
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

name: Deploy Pastel to GitHub Pages
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
        with:
          enablement: true
      - name: Fetch CC0 3D host asset
        run: |
          mkdir -p assets
          curl -L --fail --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
            -o assets/mpfb.glb \
            https://raw.githubusercontent.com/met4citizen/TalkingHead/main/avatars/mpfb.glb
          test -s assets/mpfb.glb
          file assets/mpfb.glb
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: .
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

# PASTEL Host Premium

Premium presentation layer for PASTEL PASTRY&COFFEE.

## Current implementation
- Real human female GLB avatar: assets/brunette.glb.
- TalkingHead + Three.js runtime instead of a static model-viewer scene.
- Idle head/eye movement and speaking head movement.
- Interactive hand gestures during responses.
- Faster Arabic browser speech with device Arabic voice selection.
- Lightweight mouth/jaw animation while speech is playing.
- Responsive premium PASTEL visual treatment.
- Direct WhatsApp, phone, email and map actions.
- No invented prices or customer facts.

## Runtime evidence
The previous live runtime successfully loaded the real GLB and displayed 3D Host متصل.

The current commit upgrades the renderer and interaction layer so the avatar is no longer intentionally static.

## Remaining boundary
Arabic browser speech quality remains dependent on the voice supplied by the device/browser. True phoneme-level Arabic lip-sync is not claimed yet; the current mouth animation is synchronized to the speech playback state rather than to Arabic phoneme timestamps.

Deployment is triggered by the GitHub Pages workflow on pushes to main.

# Host Standard

Reusable 3D hospitality host foundation.

## Customer customization boundary

For a new customer, the intended customer-specific surface is **host-standard/config.js**.

Change only the configuration values for:
- brand identity and copy
- colors
- approved GLB avatar
- host mood/view/camera
- UI/speech language
- verified knowledge
- contact channels
- optional TTS endpoint

The runtime, UI shell, verified-answer flow, voice fallback, and contact actions remain shared.

## Quality rules

1. The Host must present as a modern, premium hospitality representative.
2. No cartoon/game-like presentation is acceptable for the commercial baseline.
3. Customer facts must come from verified configuration/knowledge.
4. Unknown facts must not be invented.
5. Avatar assets must have commercial/public-web-app rights checked before customer deployment.
6. A source-level pass is not a browser-production pass. Live browser verification is required before calling a customer build ready.
7. Arabic browser speech is a fallback only. TalkingHead's built-in lip-sync languages do not include Arabic; true Arabic lip-sync requires a compatible audio/viseme/timestamp path.

## Current baseline avatar

The branch uses the TalkingHead MPFB reference avatar as a license-safe baseline. TalkingHead documents this reference avatar as CC0. Replace it with a customer-approved commercial GLB when a more realistic/premium character is selected.

## Architecture

```
QR / URL
  -> Host Standard UI
  -> 3D avatar runtime
  -> verified customer knowledge
  -> voice / answer
  -> WhatsApp / call / email / directions
```

The standard is designed so that PASTEL is a configuration/case study, not a separate codebase.

## Evidence status

Current branch has source/read-back verification. Browser runtime verification is still required before merge/release.

# Host Standard 3D — Repository & Collection Leverage Record

Date: 2026-10-03

## Source of truth

The production source for HOST STANDARD · 3D is:
- Repository: `salamou1944/Pastel-`
- Path: `host-standard/`
- Latest verified Pages deployment before this record: Run #46, commit `3205227ec72cc9bc9df7dee6136b5677d47af74e`, conclusion: success.
- Current follow-up fix: commit `47b51fdf90a976aa3fa50fa615173a33c3d9ff82` (bundled 3D asset path).

## Collection / repository sweep

Repositories inspected for reusable Host/3D/verification leverage:
- `salamou1944/Pastel-`
- `salamou1944/Project-`
- `salamou1944/Files-`
- `salamou1944/AI_operating_memory`
- `salamou1944/agent-skills`
- `salamou1944/Easy-`
- `salamou1944/Astra`
- `salamou1944/Astra-`
- `salamou1944/Salamou-31`

## Findings

### Pastel-
Contains the actual reusable Host Standard implementation under `host-standard/`:
UI shell, TalkingHead/Three.js path, customer configuration boundary, verified-answer rules, contact actions, and GitHub Pages deployment.

### Project- / COLLECTION
No direct replacement 3D host implementation was found. Relevant leverage is architectural:
- browser-agent / browserable style verification and interaction patterns;
- self-hostable deployment/runtime patterns;
- collection discipline that distinguishes discovery from authorization and real-host evidence from conceptual understanding.

These are references, not code to copy blindly.

### Files-, AI_operating_memory, agent-skills, Easy-, Astra-, Salamou-31
No direct HOST STANDARD · 3D implementation match was found in the repository search used for this pass.

### Astra
Search produced host/security material, but no direct reusable 3D hospitality host component suitable for adoption.

## Adoption rule

Before adding a new Host component or dependency:
1. Search owned repositories and COLLECTION first.
2. Reuse an existing implementation when it is a verified fit.
3. Do not duplicate an existing component across repositories.
4. Do not treat collection metadata as production proof.
5. Require runtime/browser evidence before calling the Host customer-ready.

## Current technical guard

The Host Standard configuration now points to the bundled `./assets/mpfb.glb` produced by the Pages workflow, rather than relying on an external raw-asset URL.
